_documentation.description: Manual overrides for OSM campus features, exclusions, skybridges, and missing structures.
Manual overrides for OSM campus features, exclusions, skybridges, custom roads, and missing structures.
_documentation.exclude_ids: List of OSM IDs to skip completely during extrusion (for junk/stray polygons)
_documentation.bridges: List of elevated skybridges ({ id, name, from: [lat, lon], to: [lat, lon], width, bottomY, height, color, roofColor } or { id, osm_id, bottomY / min_height, height, color, roofColor }) rendered floating above ground clearance
_documentation.rename_or_retag: Map OSM ID -> { name, subtitle (optional), category, floors (optional), height_m (optional), min_height (optional), bottomY (optional), tags (optional list), departments (optional list) }
_documentation.shift_footprints: Map OSM ID -> [dx_meters, dz_meters] in local 3D world space (+X East, +Z South / -Z North)
_documentation.custom_buildings: List of manual buildings missing from OSM, each with footprint as [[lat, lon], ...] polygon ring
_documentation.custom_roads: List of custom campus road/footpath polylines missing from OSM ({ id, name, subtype, points: [[lat, lon], ...] }) rendered & routed alongside OSM roads
_documentation.category_colors: Optional map of category -> hex color string (e.g. '#E6DDD0') overriding default palette colors
